name: Sentraspere Verse catalogue
description: A small, self-hosted marketplace of reusable UAS assets, behaviors, scenarios and datasets for virtual and constructive training. Instantiated by the competitor because a Government-furnished Army Verse Marketplace is not available during the prize period. Every asset carries its provenance; every value is either manufacturer-published or explicitly marked derived.

behaviors.name: Home on target with lateral weave
behaviors.description: Closes on the defended point along a curved approach, weaving across its own heading and drifting in altitude. Aims at an offset and only closes it near the end.

behaviors.name: Cross the area, loiter, depart
behaviors.description: Transits past the defended point at a lateral offset without closing on it. Civilian pattern.

behaviors.name: Orbit at standoff
behaviors.description: Holds a racetrack at altitude over the area of interest.

behaviors.name: Pursue and intercept a designated UAS
behaviors.description: Launches from the friendly platform, pursues a designated contact and engages it.

behaviors.name: Deliver munition on a designated surface target
behaviors.description: Ingress, release on a designated hostile surface target, egress.

scenarios.name: Hostile UAS threat — detect, classify, react
UAS delivers munition on hostile surface target

datasets.name: Human–AI trust calibration log
datasets.description: Per-contact record: ground truth, operator's own rules verdict, classifier verdict and stated confidence, operator action, spoofed flag, wave, and the four calibration outcomes (trusted-right, trusted-wrong, overrode-right, overrode-wrong). Heart rate and stress when a strap is worn.
